atomicity: Persist WAITING_FOR_OWNER while preserving the exact turn, action budget and confirmed checkpoint; do not start a timeout, select an action/defense, spend, roll, create a lease or advance initiative.
guards: GM authority; owning controller DISCONNECTED; actor owns the current turn or pending decision; confirmed checkpoint and revisions current; no unresolved command/reaction whose partial state would change.
reconnect: The identical wait state restores; replay has no extra effect and owner reconnect ends waiting only at a safe boundary.
title: Явно ждать возврата owningController

atomicity: Keep owningController immutable; ACTIVATE creates one lease and sets effectiveController for every decision including defense without move/spend/reroll; END invalidates old projection/hotkeys and restores previousEffectiveController or owningController while preserving turn, budget and confirmed command ownership; CANCEL clears only the pending lease/handoff envelope, commits one reason-specific cancellation receipt and follows its server-signed return path without changing a controller, action, resource, roll, turn or projection except the required privacy return receipt.
guards: ACTIVATE: GM authority, active living actor, authorized target controller, no conflicting lease or unresolved intent; local-human target has completed PLY-030 acknowledgement and prior projection erasure. END: active lease, owner available or explicit end selected, safe boundary and no uncommitted intent; current revision. CANCEL: GM authority; leaseStatus=PENDING_ACK; lease not activated; no controller/action/resource mutation; leaseReason and server-signed returnFormId match OWNER_DISCONNECTED→CMB-066, LOCAL_HANDOFF→PLY-030, or RULE_EFFECT/owner already reconnected→CMB-029; current revision.
reconnect: Same command and decision return the same receipt; active lease restores exactly; owner reconnect queues END at a safe boundary and never creates an extra turn; canceled pending lease restores CANCELED with the identical return context and cannot later activate.
title: Активировать, завершить или отменить временный ControlLease

atomicity: Persist the eligible pool and hash, seed, exactly one selectedTargetId and receipt and attach them to the origin command; perform no action/resource spend and never select outside an explicit rule.
guards: An explicit active rule requires randomness and excludes manual choice for this occurrence; server-derived legal, visible and targetable actor-specific pool is nonempty/current; GM omniscience does not enlarge it; no prior receipt; origin command remains pending before spend/roll.
reconnect: Same command/request returns the same pool, seed and target; never reroll. Later target invalidation follows the origin command's normal revalidation/failure and does not invent a second target unless an explicit rule says so.
title: Однократно выбрать случайную цель по явному правилу

atomicity: For ACTIVATE_TARGET or RETURN_INITIATOR, persist exactly one active local context and publish only its projection while keeping pending-command ownership unchanged; HOST_LOCAL_CANDIDATE opens only the local candidate/library bootstrap projection and grants no campaign authority; no action, OE, item, dose, roll or unrelated authority mutates.
guards: Target local owner explicitly acknowledged; prior projection is erased; state/projection revisions current; boundary is safe or handoff is the addressed forced nested prompt; returnContext and pending-command owner match the signed handoff envelope. For handoffType!=HOST_LOCAL_CANDIDATE, target GM/seat is admitted and authorized. For handoffType=HOST_LOCAL_CANDIDATE, isHostDevice=true, the selected provisional local owner matches the signed handoff target, remains not admitted, and has no player campaign authority.
reconnect: Same handoffId/commandId returns the same receipt and active context; reconnect restores the curtain or committed target/initiator projection without exposing the prior owner, admitting a provisional candidate or repeating a nested response.
title: Подтвердить локальную privacy-передачу активного контекста

atomicity: Create one linked PENDING CONSENT or MASTER_PREDICATE request with originating command/owner/return context; reserve no OE, action, item, dose, roll or target state.
guards: Selected ability remains in the current peace action envelope; target/parameters are eligible; exactly one required dependency kind and recipient are resolved; no prior pending response; state/projection revisions current.
reconnect: Same commandId restores the identical pending request and response if present; replay never creates a duplicate or changes a response.
title: Создать адресный запрос согласия или master predicate для мирной способности

atomicity: Create one commandId and freeze action, targets, parameters, costs and next-stage envelope; create at most one addressed rollRequestId or deterministic resolver intent; spend nothing until the resolver's final revalidation and never let the client choose a route.
guards: Effective controller owns the active actor/turn; selected action remains in its signed actor-specific availableActions; all required targets/parameters are eligible for the observer; budget, visibility and revisions current; server computes the exact next state and immutable MANUAL/AUTO snapshot.
reconnect: Same commandId restores the exact target/parameter/roll-mode/next-stage envelope; replay cannot change mode, retarget, reroll or duplicate spend.
title: Зафиксировать одиночную боевую команду и следующий адресный этап

atomicity: Create exactly one addressed rollRequestId linked to the pending peace command without reserving OE or applying any effect; persist the mode snapshot and return context.
guards: Selected peace ability and target/parameters remain in the signed envelope; every required dependency is positively resolved or explicitly exempt; requiresRoll=true; no prior request/result; immutable MANUAL/AUTO mode snapshot and revisions current.
reconnect: The same command restores the same pending roll request and can never switch mode, reroll or duplicate the eventual ability operation.
title: Создать адресный бросок мирной способности

atomicity: ABANDON_AND_CREATE irreversibly closes exactly that return window and records one receipt without creating a character; CANCEL changes nothing and creates no draft.
guards: Dead character and deathEvent match; modeled source-specific return window is still AVAILABLE; decision=ABANDON_AND_CREATE|CANCEL; player owner and state revision current.
reconnect: Same decision returns the prior receipt; missing/closed/disconnected response is never treated as abandonment.
title: Подтвердить либо отменить отказ от окна возвращения перед новым героем

atomicity: Persist one whole stage snapshot, the next signed stage, branch-cache hash and receipt together; never create a final character, runtime authority or partial stage; previously displayed random results remain byte-stable.
guards: Player owns the characterDraftId; stage-specific fields validate; draftRevision and wizardCheckpointId are current; every referenced random/decision receipt belongs to this draft and branch; a locked result is never replaceable.
reconnect: Same command returns the same checkpoint; refresh restores the last complete stage and immutable branch receipts, while an incomplete tail is ignored.
title: Атомарно сохранить валидный этап создания персонажа

atomicity: Persist exactly one face/result, receipt and resulting next-state pointer; the first display crosses the no-reroll boundary and cannot be undone by Back, refresh, branch switch or replay.
guards: Pending creationRollRequestId belongs to the draft, stage, branch and immutable AUTO/MANUAL diceInputModeSnapshot; manual face is in the exact die range or server RNG receipt is valid; no receipt exists for this request.
reconnect: Same request/command returns the stored result; a changed payload rejects and no replacement request is created.
title: Зафиксировать адресуемый бросок или ручной ввод создания персонажа

atomicity: Persist one decision receipt and server-signed next branch; abandonment never deletes provenance, branch restore never generates a seed, and cancel before commit changes nothing.
guards: Player owns the current draft/branch; decision belongs to the closed state-specific domain; referenced set/branch receipts and revision are current; an abandonment or interaction consequence is confirmed explicitly before its irreversible boundary.
reconnect: Committed decision and destination restore exactly; missing/closed/disconnected input is not a decision and cannot reroll or revive an abandoned set.
title: Зафиксировать выбор ветви или необратимое решение wizard

atomicity: Publish one restore receipt with the exact signed resumeFormId and immutable branch-cache/random receipts; do not apply an uncommitted tail, reroll, mutate a final sheet or let a client route select the destination.
guards: Checkpoint owner and entity kind match the active local owner; integrity/hash and lastCompleteCheckpointRevision validate; resumeFormId is on the entity-specific server/local-authoritative allowlist; corrupt incomplete tail is excluded.
reconnect: Same restore command returns the same receipt and destination; a corrupt or missing checkpoint exposes only a diagnostic and role-safe local return.
title: Восстановить последний целый локальный checkpoint

atomicity: Append one local metadata revision without changing stats, skills, symbionts, inventory, random provenance, candidate snapshots or campaign copies.
guards: Local owner controls the final sheet; only name, description and art asset fields differ; mechanics checksum, creation receipts and final snapshot remain identical; metadata revision current.
reconnect: Same command returns the same metadata version; stale revision changes nothing.
title: Версионно изменить локальные метаданные финального персонажа

atomicity: Persist one immutable proposed profile, validation proof/receipt and PENDING_GM request without creating/equipping a weapon or changing another draft stage.
guards: Owned unfinished character draft; weapon type/variant allowed; one common L/Lw/Ls witness makes every requested output reachable; independent manufacturing dice and draft revision fixed; no prior request receipt.
reconnect: Same request/command restores the identical profile and receipt; changed witness/dice/profile is rejected and never creates a second request.
title: Отправить валидированную заявку оружия игрока

atomicity: Spend exact XP, lock the chosen exclusive branch when applicable, learn one node and recalculate level/maxOE together; no partial spend or second node.
guards: Owned xpEligible symbiont; exact nodeRef not learned; prerequisites and AND/OR/XOR branch valid; enough XP; tree/state revisions current.
reconnect: Same command returns the prior node/XP/branch receipt; stale tree or replay never spends twice.
title: Купить один узел развития симбионта

atomicity: In one transaction subtract exactly amount from unallocated XP and add exactly amount×allocationXpMultiplier to one symbiont. Apply the race multiplier once and persist debit, credited XP, multiplier and resulting balances in one receipt.
guards: Owned character and xpEligible symbiont; integer amount 1..unallocatedXpBefore; allocationXpMultiplier is server-derived from the current owner race snapshot (FREE=2, every other race=1); GM_DIRECT source is not converted through this balance; state revision current.
reconnect: Same command returns the prior debit/multiplier/credit receipt; stale race, balance or changed amount writes nothing and replay never applies ×2 twice.
title: Распределить нераспределённый XP симбионту

atomicity: Consume the exact slot/source and append one skill learn/upgrade receipt together; no illegal prerequisite bypass or partial slot spend.
guards: Skill/sourcePool allowed; requirements and slot source valid at skill-stage/current state; targetBonus is exactly next legal value and below absolute cap; revision current.
reconnect: Same command returns the prior skill/slot receipt; stale requirements or replay never upgrades twice.
title: Изучить или повысить один навык

atomicity: Persist one seed, chosen percent, immutable generated composition, preview receipt/hash and constraints; create no runtime actor or template write.
guards: GM authority; stable eligible partyGroupSnapshot and allowedOrigins; generator status NOT_GENERATED; 80..150 percent and caps valid; combat draft revision current.
reconnect: Same command restores the exact seed/composition/hash; replay cannot reroll.
title: Однократно сгенерировать preview группы противников

atomicity: Deep-clone every accepted generated row into independent runtime UUIDs and attach all to the combat draft, or create none; templates remain unchanged.
guards: GM authority; decision=ACCEPT; preview receipt/hash and party snapshot current; all generated rows still allowed; combat draft current; no prior acceptance.
reconnect: Same command returns the same runtime UUID set; changed preview/hash is rejected before clone.
title: Принять сгенерированную группу противников

atomicity: Move exact ammo and spend full reload action cost in one transaction, updating weapon/source stack and availableActions together; otherwise move/spend none.
guards: Effective controller owns active actor; OP-RELOAD is in fresh availableActions; exact weapon/magazine/ammo compatible; source quantity and full action budget sufficient; revisions current.
reconnect: Same command returns prior ammo/action receipt; stale inventory or budget changes nothing.
title: Атомарно перезарядить оружие

atomicity: Remove the world instance and add the same item instance/quantity to actor inventory while spending the exact action cost, all or none.
guards: operationKind=PICKUP; effective controller owns actor; item visible, available and adjacent at exact scenePoint; capacity/action cost and revisions valid; OP-PICKUP available.
reconnect: Same command restores the ownership receipt; item cannot be picked up twice or from a stale point.
title: Подобрать соседний runtime-предмет

atomicity: Remove the world instance and restore the exact item instance/quantity to its original thrower once without template mutation or duplication.
guards: operationKind=RETURN; committed eligible player-victory result; runtime item remains unpicked and returnable; originalThrowerId/inventory/capacity current; no prior return.
reconnect: Same command returns prior return receipt; picked, ineligible or already returned item changes nothing.
title: Вернуть неподыбранный брошенный предмет метателю

atomicity: Resolve one request and create one unequipped WeaponProfileVersion in the campaign copy. APPROVE preserves validated profile; override persists typed diff/reason. No source local-sheet mutation.
guards: GM authority; mode=REQUEST_REVIEW; exact PENDING request and OP-REQ-VALIDATE receipt; common L/Lw/Ls witness/profile current; decision APPROVE or MASTER_OVERRIDE; override is structurally allowed and has reason.
reconnect: Same request/command returns the prior version/decision receipt; opposite or changed payload is rejected.
title: Утвердить или типизированно переопределить оружейную заявку

atomicity: Create the wound if needed and its one per-wound bleeding instance with source/damage together; append audit; never encode death as removable effect.
guards: GM authority; target/region/source valid; exact existing or newly prepared woundInstanceId; positive damagePerTick; EFF-WOUND-BLEEDING schema/stack and state revision current.
reconnect: Same command returns prior wound/bleeding receipt; stale/replay never creates a second instance or tick.
title: Создать рану и применить кровотечение

atomicity: Create burning or merge by maximum remaining duration and maximum damagePerTick, with no immediate extra tick; append one audit receipt.
guards: GM authority; target, positive duration/damage and source valid; EFF-FIRE-BURNING schema and state revision current.
reconnect: Same command returns prior merged values; stale/replay never adds a tick or extends twice.
title: Применить или усилить горение

atomicity: Append exactly one house-rule version with conflictId, short text, scene scope, reason, author and timestamp; increment version once and create one clarification receipt. Existing versions are immutable and no gameplay delta occurs in this commit.
guards: Confirmed sole GM authority; exact campaign/conflict and sceneScope; shortRuleText and reason present; beforeRoll=true and no linked roll receipt exists; houseRuleVersionBefore and state/master revisions current; payload contains no action, target, resource, effect, die or free mechanical field.
reconnect: Same commandId returns the identical version/receipt; stale version, post-roll submission or changed payload writes nothing and cannot replace an earlier version.
title: Сохранить версионированное уточнение Last clarity

atomicity: Re-read both currentOE values immediately before one outcome. GREATER: subtract victim currentOE, destroy that victim and occupy its slot. LOWER: destroy Guardian and subtract its pre-battle currentOE from the winner. EQUAL: change no OE, expel Guardian to target coordinates and block another capture this turn. Never choose a hidden/random victim.
guards: Owned Guardian is OUTSIDE_BODY; target is a voluntary, unconscious or fully immobilized United/Free body with at least one symbiont; selected victim belongs to the complete disclosed target list; one action, target position and revisions are current; same-turn tie retry is absent.
reconnect: Same commandId returns the identical comparison and outcome receipt; a changed victim, target or revision is rejected before action/OE/body mutation.
title: Разрешить захват выбранного тела Хранителем

atomicity: PAUSE preserves every participant and reservation. RESOLVE_ONE applies the strict currentOE result once: win deletes the victim, spends its OE and reserves one random fitting absent saved species without duplication; loss destroys Guardian; tie changes no OE and pauses. The player may leave any unselected resident symbiont.
guards: First slot was won in a United host; configuration is not FINALIZED; decision=RESOLVE_ONE|PAUSE; for RESOLVE_ONE the player selected one remaining resident symbiont and both currentOE values plus capacity/template set are current.
reconnect: Each duel/decision ID restores the same result, random saved-species reservation and pause state; replay never repeats deletion, OE spend or selection.
title: Разрешить либо приостановить следующий бой Попутчиков

atomicity: Keep selected survivors and current reservations, irreversibly discard every unrecovered saved template, close the automatic duel sequence and persist one final configuration receipt. A Free host has no sequence and loses companion genetic material by rule.
guards: Guardian owns the captured United host; companion sequence is ACTIVE or PAUSED; full survivors, growing reservations, free capacity and unrecovered saved templates are displayed; explicit irreversible confirmation and current revision present.
reconnect: Same finalization returns the prior receipt; after commit no duel or discarded-template restoration CTA can reappear.
title: Необратимо подтвердить финальную конфигурацию Попутчиков

atomicity: Mark the selected assistant infections destroyed together without action/OE cost. Do not remove a separate plague disease and do not undo an already fully resolved effect; invalidate only still-pending assistant-dependent resolutions according to their normal guard.
guards: Player owns this PLAGUE_DOCTOR instance; every selected infection is ACTIVE and was created by this exact Doctor; selection and infectedRegistryRevision current; command may occur free/out-of-turn, including after another action declaration but before its resolution.
reconnect: Same commandId returns the identical destroyed set and receipt; stale or foreign infection IDs change nothing.
title: Добровольно уничтожить выбранных ассистентов Чумного доктора

atomicity: Persist the three interval values, their three cumulative sums and a locked GM-only receipt together; player projections expose only devouredCount and opened slots, never intervals, thresholds or distance to next threshold.
guards: Confirmed GM authority; exact CHIMERA instance; exactly three independently entered integers 10..22; threshold configuration UNSET; current authority/state revision.
reconnect: Same commandId returns the locked configuration; changed payload or later edit is rejected without replacing values.
title: Зафиксировать три скрытых интервала Химеры

atomicity: Append one EXTERNAL history event, increment devouredCount once and open at most the newly crossed hidden slots in one transaction. Ordinary app-run completions are rejected from this command and are recorded automatically by OP-CHIMERA-DEVOUR.
guards: Confirmed GM authority; thresholds locked; event happened outside the application or before import; unique externalEventId, occurredAt, target reference, provenance and completion evidence valid; no app-runtime receipt or prior event match.
reconnect: Same externalEventId/payload returns the prior receipt; duplicate, changed or app-runtime events never increment count or slots.
title: Зафиксировать внешнее завершённое Пожирание Химеры
